posting_windows.sample: brief posts with a complete impressions snapshot
posting_windows.signals: reach (impressions, all measured briefs) and engagement rate (engagements / impressions, briefs with above-median reach only), each hour vs the rest of the day, Mann-Whitney + Cliff's delta, Holm-corrected across all hour x signal contrasts
posting_windows.instruction: When assigning posting_time, prefer recommended_hours and never use avoid_hours, but keep the day's usual shape: the same number of posts, spread across the day, at least 20 minutes apart, no more than 2 posts in any one hour, and within the caps of 5 posts 6AM-noon, 4 posts noon-6PM, 3 posts 6PM-midnight CT. Hours without a verdict are neutral. If recommended_hours is empty, keep the current schedule.
posting_windows.note: No hour cleared the Holm-corrected significance gates against the rest of the day; keep the current schedule.

methodology.test: Mann-Whitney U (two-sided, tie-corrected, normal approximation with continuity correction)
methodology.rationale: Impression counts are heavily right-skewed; rank-based tests are robust to that shape. Cliff's delta floor of 0.20 excludes tiny-but-significant differences that aren't practically actionable.

In case you missed Cubs news today:

> ✍️ Seiya Suzuki got a $23.15M qualifying offer. He has until 3 PM CT on Nov. 17 to accept or decline
   - Ian Happ did not get one
   - If Suzuki signs elsewhere, the Cubs get draft pick compensation

> 👋 Clay Holmes declined his $12M player option and is now a free agent
   - He had a 4.25 ERA in 9 starts after the deadline trade

> 📉 The Cubs declined Colin Rea's $7.5M option
   - The swingman threw 137 innings with a 4.34 ERA, making 19 starts and 15 relief appearances

> 🔁 Hunter Harvey and Caleb Thielbar are free agents after their mutual options weren't picked up

> 🤝 Jacob Webb is back on a new deal: $2.5M guaranteed, with a $4M club option for 2028
   - He posted a 3.36 ERA with 9 saves in 68 games

> ➕ The Cubs claimed reliever Eric Orze off waivers from the Twins (5.66 ERA in 36 games this year)

> 🏥 Cade Horton, Justin Steele, Ben Brown, Porter Hodge, Shelby Miller, Phil Maton and Riley Martin came off the 60-day IL, and Tyler Austin was outrighted to Iowa

> 💰 The Cubs reportedly "badly want" Tarik Skubal but are skeptical they'll pay the $300M-plus he's expected to get
   - The Dodgers and Mets are seen as the top bidders

> 🦾 Padres lefty Adrián Morejón also got a qualifying offer and has been floated as a Cubs bullpen fit

> 🆓 The exclusive window closed at 4 PM CT, so free agency is officially open

> 🔴 NL Central: The Brewers picked up William Contreras's $14.5M option and gave Jake Bauers a qualifying offer

> ⚾ Around MLB: Eight players got qualifying offers, including Randy Arozarena, David Bednar and Brandon Lowe. The Astros picked up Isaac Paredes's $13.35M option, and the Tigers declined Kenley Jansen's $12M option

One of these every night. Follow for the daily Cubs recap.

#Cubs

In case you missed Cubs news today:

> 🎯 Ken Rosenthal expects the Cubs to sign or trade for two starting pitchers this winter: "I'm not sure the internal options are sufficient"
   - Shota Imanaga, Kevin Gausman, Clay Holmes, David Peterson, Matthew Boyd and Colin Rea are all free agents

> 🧤 Top prospect Josiah Hartshorn won a Minor League Gold Glove, picked as the best defensive first baseman in all of MiLB
   - Just 5 errors in 440 chances (.989) across three levels
   - The 19-year-old also hit 23 homers with 112 RBIs in his first full pro season

> 🌵 Outfielder Kade Snell made the Arizona Fall League's Fall Stars Game (Sunday, 8 PM ET on MLB Network)
   - He's hitting .286/.438/.381 with 9 steals in 17 games
   - Dominick Reid was also named but won't play

> 📊 MLB.com's way-too-early 2027 Power Rankings have the Cubs at No. 7. The Brewers are No. 1

> 🦾 More free-agent predictions with a Cubs angle:
   - Adrián Morejón to the Cubs (2 of 3 picks)
   - Trevor Rogers to the Cubs (1 of 3 picks)

> 🔄 The Mariners, who just hired Jason Kanzler away from the Cubs, are reportedly poking around on trading some of their starting pitching for a bat

> 🔁 Minor league free agency is here: 12 Cubs farmhands hit the market, including Kohl Franklin and Tyler Austin

> 🔴 NL Central: The Cardinals are hiring White Sox assistant Joel McKeithan as hitting coach, and the Reds named Joe Torres pitching coach. The A's hired Brewers player development exec Cam Castro as their GM

> ⚾ Around MLB: The Rangers say "there will be changes," and Corey Seager, Jacob deGrom and Nathan Eovaldi ($92M of a roughly $190M payroll) are expected to be shopped. All three have full no-trade protection

One of these every night. Follow for the daily Cubs recap.

#Cubs

In case you missed Cubs news today:

> 💎 Pete Crow-Armstrong wins the NL Platinum Glove
   - Named the best defender in the National League at any position, his first Platinum Glove
   - First Cub to win it since Anthony Rizzo in 2016, and the first NL center fielder ever to take it
   - Led the majors with +26 Outs Above Average
   - Former Cub Cody Bellinger won it in the AL

> 🧤 The Cubs also win the NL Gold Glove Team Award
   - Best defensive team in the National League for the second straight year
   - Third overall (2020, 2025, 2026), tied with the Blue Jays for the most
   - MLB-best +72 Outs Above Average, +115 Defensive Runs Saved and a .990 fielding percentage

> 🏆 PCA isn't done collecting hardware
   - NL MVP is announced Nov. 12, and he's a finalist
   - Silver Slugger winners Nov. 17: PCA, Seiya Suzuki and Alex Bregman are finalists, and the Cubs are up for Offensive Team of the Year

> 💰 The Tarik Skubal market is taking shape
   - The Dodgers and Mets are seen as the top suitors, with the Cubs expected to at least be involved
   - His price is expected to land well above $300M; the biggest contract in Cubs history is still Jason Heyward's $184M

> 🌟 Kade Snell plays in the Arizona Fall League Fall Stars Game
   - Sunday, 8 PM ET on MLB Network

> 📅 Hot stove calendar
   - GM Meetings Nov. 10-12 in Las Vegas
   - Suzuki's deadline on his $23.15M qualifying offer is Nov. 17
   - The CBA expires Dec. 1, and a lockout would freeze free agency

> ⚾ Around MLB
   - The Nationals extended CF Jacob Young: four years, $23M
   - Max Scherzer plans to pitch in "lockout games" this winter to decide whether he'll play in 2027

One of these every night. Follow for the daily Cubs recap.
